title: FANET UAV Simulation Framework: Code and Reproducible Benchmarks
description: Open-source Python FANET models, routing and wireless-channel benchmarks, UAV AirSim simulator trajectory replay, and paired ns-3 network validation code with provenance-aware data and documentation.
